context.failure_reason: 1) AsyncMock side_effect delivers all responses before call_tool registers pending futures, so responses are discarded. 2) asyncio.create_task rejects _GatheringFuture (not a coroutine).
context.resolution: 1) Used asyncio.Queue as mock reader — feed responses after futures registered. 2) asyncio.ensure_future instead of create_task for gather result.

deviations.description: Runtime run() reads directly from reader instead of using IpcClient._response_handler
deviations.reason: IpcClient._response_handler runs as background task reading all messages. Runtime needs the same reader for ExecuteMsg/CancelMsg/PingMsg. Can't have two readers on one stream. Runtime reads directly and dispatches tool_result to IpcClient._pending manually.
deviations.plan_gap: Plan doesn't specify how runtime and IpcClient share the single socket reader
deviations.impact: Low — IpcClient still works standalone (connect+_response_handler). Runtime integrates differently but behavior is identical.

decisions_made.decision: IpcClient has standalone connect()+_response_handler() for independent use, but runtime.run() reads the socket directly
decisions_made.reason: Can't have two readers on one asyncio stream. Runtime dispatches tool_result to IpcClient._pending manually.
Test spec requires timeout test. asyncio.wait_for wraps the pending future.

decisions_made.decision: Runtime uses late import of IpcClient inside run() to avoid circular imports
decisions_made.reason: ipc_sandbox imports from ipc_protocol; runtime imports from both. Late import keeps the dependency tree clean.
